title: Actionable exercise: Tracing a page from URL to component
text: Are server handlers that return data or perform actions, often with shared logic coming from lib. I also kept track of support folders like public, assets, scripts, and SQL because they matter whenever the task involves static files, automation, or database-related work. The main takeaway from this week is that understanding the repo first is real progress. The strength was building a reliable mental model before editing live code. The next step is to use that map to make targeted changes, debug issues faster, and help future contributors ramp up more quickly. Your turn. If you are new to this repository, start by tracing one real page from its URL to app, then to layout, then to the components and any API calls behind it. That one exercise will quickly show you where most future changes belong. Follow Humanitarians AI for more project progress videos and research explainers.
